content.text:
The suite is green now: 2 tests pass and 0 fail.

The test wasn't flaky. It was catching a real bug. `invoiceDate` in `invoice.js` used local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`). The comment says invoices are dated in UTC, and the test sets `TZ=Asia/Tokyo` to match CI. At 23:30 UTC the local date in Tokyo is already the next day, so the invoice came out as `2026-03-06` instead of `2026-03-05`.

I switched the function to the UTC getters (`getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth`, `getUTCDate`). I didn't skip or change any test. This also changes behavior in production, because invoices on any server not running in UTC would have carried the wrong date near midnight.
